data.name: Variant Channeling - Fate
data.description: Heal - Creatures gain a +%1 channel bonus on one d20 roll made during their next readied action as long as it is taken before the end of your next turn. Harm - Creatures gain a -%1 channel penalty on ability checks and skill checks for 1 minute.|ChannelModifier
